query: Phelps Land Works Inc, Port St. Lucie, FL
name: Phelps Land Works Inc
address: 2422 SE Alfonso Ave, Port St. Lucie, FL 34952, United States

reviewSamples.author: Gian
reviewSamples.text: Great work. Great price. Someone referred him to me and I will do the same. I had 3 big stumps, as large as 52 inches in diameter but he did a great job grinding them until there was nothing left. I had surface roots that were quite big

reviewSamples.author: Allen Richards
reviewSamples.text: Tony and his guy came on time and were very efficient. I called a total of 6 different companies and all of them wanted to charge me a minimum fee of either $300 or $400. I called Tony and he came out and took care of it for a reasonable price. It was only a bush stump. Approximately (7) 1 inch stems sticking up from the ground.

reviewSamples.author: OG
reviewSamples.text: Excellent. Professional. And just a great person. I cannot say how much we appreciate all that Tony is. Great to deal with, communication and prompt service. Does exactly what he says he is going to do when he says he is going to do it. I don't take that for granted, it is surprising how many fail at that. Thank you Tony.

reviewSamples.author: Ryan John
reviewSamples.text: Phelps responded quickly to give me a quote and to do the work. I would recommend them to anyone who needed any tree work done. Thank you

reviewSamples.author: Katie Wright
reviewSamples.text: This is a great company to have. They came out during the time that I needed them too. Also Tony did a wonderful job. He is very kind. I recommend him highly.
